rules.chapter: Chapter I — Preliminary
rules.title: Definitions
rules.text_verbatim: In these rules, unless the context otherwise requires: (a) 'Act' means the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (1 of 2010); (b) 'combination package' means a package containing two or more individual packages of different commodities; (bb) 'E-commerce' means buying and selling of goods and services including digital products over digital and electronic network; (bbb) 'E-commerce entity' means an e-commerce entity as defined in clause (b) of sub-rule (1) of rule 2 of the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020; (c) 'dealer' in relation to any packaged commodity, means a person who, or a firm or a Hindu undivided family which, carries on directly or otherwise, the business of buying, selling, supplying or distributing any such commodity; (d) 'group package' means a package containing two or more individual packages of the same commodity; (e) 'maximum permissible error' in relation to the quantity contained in an individual package, means an error in deficiency specified in the First Schedule; (f) 'net quantity' in relation to commodity contained in a package, means the quantity by weight, measure or number of such commodity contained in that package excluding the weight of wrapper or container; (g) 'principal display panel' in relation to a package, means the total surface area of the package where mandatory declarations are given; (h) 'retail package' means the packages which are intended for retail sale to the ultimate consumer; (i) 'retail sale price' or 'MRP' means the maximum price at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the ultimate consumer inclusive of all taxes.
rules.applies_to: Statutory definitions for all terms used in compliance engine

amendment_history.change_summary: E-commerce and E-commerce entity definitions added

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Applicability of Chapter II
rules.text_verbatim: The provisions of this Chapter shall not apply to: (a) packages of commodities containing quantity of more than 25 kg or 25 litre; (b) cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kg; (c) packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers.
rules.applies_to: Exemption scope of Chapter II retail packaging rules
exceptions_and_provisos: Does not apply to packages above 25kg/25L or industrial/institutional sales.

amendment_history.change_summary: Scope refined for industrial and institutional packages

rules.notes_for_engine: Suppress false positive retail violations if package > 25kg/25L or sold to industrial/institutional users.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Regulation for pre-packing and sale of commodities
rules.text_verbatim: No person shall pre-pack or cause or permit to be pre-packed any commodity for sale, distribution or delivery unless the package bears thereon or on the label securely affixed thereto, such declarations as are required to be made under these rules.
rules.applies_to: Core prohibition against unlabelled or non-compliant pre-packed commodities
rules.notes_for_engine: Foundational rule establishing liability for missing mandatory label declarations.

rules.title: Specific commodities to be packed in standard packages

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Declaration of Name and Address of Manufacturer/Packer/Importer
rules.text_verbatim: Every package shall bear thereon: (a) the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and complete address of the manufacturer and packer and in case of any imported package the name and complete address of the importer.
rules.applies_to: Manufacturer, Packer, and Importer identity and address
exceptions_and_provisos: Where package capacity <= 10 cm³, address may be marked elsewhere per Rule 10 proviso.
rules.notes_for_engine: Check presence of registered name and complete postal address.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Country of Origin for Imported Packages
rules.text_verbatim: (aa) the name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported packages shall be mentioned on the package.
rules.applies_to: Country of origin declaration on imported commodities

amendment_history.change_summary: Sub-clause (aa) inserted requiring Country of Origin

rules.notes_for_engine: Flag violation if country of origin is omitted on imported package.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Generic or Common Name of Commodity
rules.text_verbatim: (b) the common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product shall be mentioned on the package.
rules.applies_to: Generic name of commodity
exceptions_and_provisos: Must state common/generic name, not just brand trade name.
rules.notes_for_engine: Must state generic product identity.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Net Quantity Declaration
rules.text_verbatim: (c) the net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of the commodity contained in the package shall be mentioned.
rules.applies_to: Net quantity declaration in metric SI units
rules.notes_for_engine: Must use SI metric units.

rules.title: Retail Sale Price (MRP Inclusive of All Taxes)
rules.text_verbatim: (e) the retail sale price of the package shall clearly indicate that it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes, and the price in Indian Rupees shall be given in the format: 'Maximum Retail Price Rs. XX.XX (inclusive of all taxes)' or 'MRP Rs. XX.XX (incl. of all taxes)'.
rules.applies_to: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) declaration exact phrasing

amendment_history.change_summary: Standardized MRP formatting and tax inclusion clause

rules.notes_for_engine: Exact wording match required for inclusive of all taxes clause.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Customer Care Contact Framework
rules.text_verbatim: (2) Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, e-mail address, if any, of the person who who can be contacted by the consumer in case of consumer complaints.
rules.applies_to: Consumer care contact details (Name, Address, Phone, Email)
rules.notes_for_engine: Must validate presence of all 4 customer care contact attributes.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Principal Display Panel Area and Minimum Letter/Numeral Height (Table-I)
rules.text_verbatim: (2) The height of any numeral and letter in the declaration on the principal display panel shall not be less than as specified in Table-I: Table-I: (1) Area <= 50 cm²: min 1.0 mm (1.5 mm if blown/molded/embossed); (2) 50 < Area <= 100 cm²: min 1.5 mm (2.0 mm if embossed); (3) 100 < Area <= 500 cm²: min 2.5 mm (4.0 mm if embossed); (4) 500 < Area <= 2500 cm²: min 4.0 mm (6.0 mm if embossed); (5) Area > 2500 cm²: min 6.0 mm (6.0 mm if embossed).
rules.applies_to: Numeral and letter height calibration matrix on PDP
exceptions_and_provisos: Width of letter/numeral shall not be less than 1/3 of its height except for numeral 1 and letter I.

amendment_history.change_summary: Table-I substituted; Table-II omitted; uniform application

source.document: Department of Consumer Affairs — Notification G.S.R. 629(E)

rules.notes_for_engine: Core vision engine calibration rule for numeral & letter height validation.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Principal Display Panel Area Calculation Method
rules.text_verbatim: (4) The area of the principal display panel shall be: (a) in the case of a rectangular package, the product of height and width; (b) in the case of a cylindrical package, 40 percent of the product of height and circumference; (c) in any other shape, 40 percent of total surface area excluding top, bottom, flanges, and neck of bottle.
rules.applies_to: PDP Surface Area (A) geometric calculation
exceptions_and_provisos: Exclude caps, flanges, necks, and shoulders of containers.
rules.notes_for_engine: Geometry calculation engine for PDP surface area.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Declaration Placement and Clear Space Space Margin
rules.text_verbatim: Every declaration required to be made under these rules shall be clear, legible and prominent. The net quantity declaration shall have a clear space surrounding it equal to the height of the lettering or numeral used.
rules.applies_to: Clear space surrounding net quantity declaration
exceptions_and_provisos: Returnable glass bottles crown cap exception.
rules.notes_for_engine: Clear space bounding margin check.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Manner of Declaration — Language and Contrast
rules.text_verbatim: (1) Declarations shall be in Hindi in Devanagari script or in English. (2) Declarations shall be printed in contrasting color to the background of the label.
rules.applies_to: Label language and color contrast legibility
rules.notes_for_engine: Language must be Hindi or English.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Declaration of Unit Sale Price
rules.text_verbatim: Unit sale price shall be declared on pre-packaged commodities in terms of rupees per gram, kg, ml, litre, metre, or number.
rules.applies_to: Unit sale price mandatory formats
rules.notes_for_engine: Unit sale price format validation.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: General provisions relating to declaration of quantity
rules.text_verbatim: The declaration of quantity shall exclude the weight of wrapper or container. Qualifier 'when packed' allowed only for commodities specified in Third Schedule.
rules.applies_to: Net quantity exclusion of tare weight and 'when packed' qualifiers
rules.notes_for_engine: Prohibits 'when packed' unless item is listed in Third Schedule.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Manner of quantity declaration and prohibition of misleading qualifiers
rules.text_verbatim: No declaration of quantity shall be qualified by words like 'approximate', 'about', 'minimum' or words of similar import.
rules.applies_to: Prohibition of vague or misleading quantity qualifiers
rules.notes_for_engine: Flag violation if net quantity includes prohibited qualifiers like 'approx' or 'about'.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Symbols of units of weight, measure or number
rules.text_verbatim: Symbols for SI units: g for gram, kg for kilogram, ml for millilitre, l or L for litre, cm for centimetre, m for metre. Non-standard symbols like doz, gross prohibited.
rules.applies_to: SI unit symbol standardization
rules.notes_for_engine: Enforce SI unit symbols.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Specific Commodity Declarations (Textiles, Foil, Containers)
rules.text_verbatim: Rules 14-17 prescribe dimensions for bedsheets, towels, usable sheet counts for tissues/foil, and container sizes.
rules.applies_to: Textiles, paper tissues, aluminum foil, and container declarations
rules.notes_for_engine: Dimension & count requirements.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Wholesale and Retail Dealer Obligations — Price Integrity
rules.text_verbatim: No dealer shall sell any commodity in packaged form at a price exceeding the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) declared thereon. No alteration or overwriting of MRP permitted.
rules.applies_to: Retail price integrity and prohibition of overcharging above MRP
exceptions_and_provisos: Price revision after tax change requires statutory public notice.
rules.notes_for_engine: Prohibits selling above MRP or defacing price stickers.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions applicable to packages intended for retail sale
rules.title: Inspection, Sampling, Testing, MPE, and Deceptive Packages
rules.text_verbatim: Rules 19 to 23 govern statutory inspection by Legal Metrology Officers, sampling per Fifth Schedule, net quantity testing per Sixth Schedule, First Schedule MPE compliance, and seizure of deceptive packages.
rules.applies_to: Inspection sampling, MPE compliance, and seizure of deceptive packages
rules.notes_for_engine: Procedural inspection and sampling guidelines.

rules.chapter: Chapters III, IV, V — Wholesale, Export/Import, Exemptions
rules.title: Wholesale Declarations, Export/Import Rules, and Exempted Packages
rules.text_verbatim: Rule 24 specifies wholesale package declarations. Rule 25 governs export/import relabeling. Rule 26 exempts packages containing quantity <= 10g or 10ml, fast food, and certain medical formulations.
rules.applies_to: Wholesale packages, export/import relabeling, and <=10g/10ml package exemptions
rules.notes_for_engine: Exempt packages <= 10g or 10ml from retail declarations except tobacco.

rules.chapter: Chapter VI — Registration of Manufacturers, Packers and Importers
rules.title: LMPC Mandatory Registration and Register Maintenance
rules.text_verbatim: Every manufacturer, packer or importer of pre-packaged commodities shall register with the Controller of Legal Metrology or Director with prescribed fee (Rs 500) within 90 days of commencement.
rules.applies_to: LMPC Mandatory Registration Certificate for manufacturers/packers/importers
rules.notes_for_engine: LMPC certificate validation.

rules.chapter: Chapter VII — General (Advertisements, Penalties, Compounding)
rules.title: Advertisements, Penalties, Compounding of Offences, and Relaxation
rules.text_verbatim: Rule 31: Advertisements must state net quantity and retail price. Rule 32: Fine up to Rs 4,000 for Rule 27/28 violations; Rs 5,000 general default. Rule 32A: Compounding offences table.
rules.applies_to: Advertisement compliance, statutory fines, compounding of offences

amendment_history.change_summary: Compounding of offences table introduced in Rule 32A

rules.notes_for_engine: Statutory fine and penalty reference table.

schedules.title: Maximum Permissible Errors on Net Quantity Declared by Weight or Volume
schedules.text_verbatim: Table I specifies Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) in deficiency: (1) <= 50 g/ml: 9.0%; (2) 50-100 g/ml: 4.5 g/ml; (3) 100-200 g/ml: 4.5%; (4) 200-500 g/ml: 3.0%; (5) 500-1000 g/ml: 15.0 g/ml; (6) > 1000 g/ml: 1.5%.
schedules.applies_to: Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) calculation on packaged commodity weight/volume
